blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Первый раз за ___ (этот год, acc. sg.) Даша подумала о «новом».
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **этот → этот** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with год). «этот» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (m. sg.): этот · этого · этому · этот (inan.) / этого (anim.) · этим · этом.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Гарин говорил вкрадчиво, совсем по-другому, чем десять ___ (минута, gen. pl.) назад.
exercises.why: **минута → минут** (gen. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural минуты. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (G. pl. газет). Ending -а → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. минута · минуты · минуте · минуту · минутой · минуте; pl. минуты · минут · минутам · минуты · минутами · минутах.  Genitive plural, the four basic types: I — nom. sing. in a consonant (стол, нож): -ов, столов; II — in -ь or a sibilant (словарь, тетрадь): -ей, словарей, тетрадей, ножей; III — in -а, -о (газета, слово): no ending, газет, слов; IV — in -(и)я, -(и)е (лекция, здание): -й, лекций, зданий. — DLI, Lessons 38–41.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Это заняло ___ (весь вечер, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **вечер → вечер** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **весь → весь** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with вечер). «весь» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (m. sg.): весь · всего · всему · весь (inan.) / всего (anim.) · всем · всём.  Declension: sg. вечер · вечера · вечеру · вечер · вечером · вечере; pl. вечера · вечеров · вечерам · вечера · вечерами · вечерах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В ___ (та ночь, acc. sg.) было облачно.
exercises.why: **ночь → ночь** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's часть — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. часть). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **тот → ту** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with ночь). «тот» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (f. sg.): та · той · той · ту · той · той.  Declension: sg. ночь · ночи · ночи · ночь · ночью · ночи; pl. ночи · ночей · ночам · ночи · ночами · ночах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Прилет самолета в Гонолулу намечен на ___ (завтрашнее утро, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The airplane is scheduled to arrive at Honolulu tomorrow morning.
exercises.why: **утро → утро** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **завтрашний → завтрашнее** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with утро). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий (every form has the same endings): A. синее. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. утро · утра · утру · утро · утром · утре; pl. утра · утр · утрам · утра · утрами · утрах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: И когда-нибудь, потом, через ___ (год, acc. pl.), с жизнию, может, и поймешь, что они значили.
exercises.why: **год → годы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural годы. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Its forms (m. sg.): этот · этого · этому · этот (inan.) / этого (anim.) · этим · этом.  Declension: sg. месяц · месяца · месяцу · месяц · месяцем · месяце; pl. месяцы · месяцев · месяцам · месяцы · месяцами · месяцах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Уже ___ (столетие, acc. sg.) назад заменил Мицкевич «изменника» — «ренегатом».
exercises.why: **столетие → столетие** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. столетие · столетия · столетию · столетие · столетием · столетии; pl. столетия · столетий · столетиям · столетия · столетиями · столетиях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. exercises.q: Если вдуматься, дожди шли ___ (целая неделя, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Come to think of it, it has been raining for a week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's неделя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. неделю). Ending -я → -ю.  **целый → целую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with неделю). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Так говорили в ___ (шестидесятый год, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: People said so in the sixties.
exercises.why: **год → годы** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural годы. Declines like DLI's стол — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. столы). Ending — (no ending) → -ы.  **шестидесятый → шестидесятые** (acc. pl., agreeing with годы). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Ты не поедешь в Боснию на ___ (каникулы, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: You aren't going to Bosnia on vacation.
exercises.why: **каникулы → каникулы** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun (it has no singular); nominative plural каникулы. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): каникулы · каникул · каникулам · каникулы · каникулами · каникулах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Том выиграл в лотерею, но через ___ (год, acc. sg.) разорился.
exercises.prompt: Tom won the lottery, but went bankrupt a year later.
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: За ___ (одно лето, acc. sg.) сколько новых изб поставили.
exercises.why: **лето → лето** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **один → одно** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with лето). «один» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (n. sg.): одно · одного · одному · одно · одним · одном.  Declension: sg. лето · лета · лету · лето · летом · лете; pl. — · — · — · — · — · —.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Погоду за ___ (сутки, acc. pl.) назад, непогоду за сутки вперед угадывает.
exercises.why: **сутки → сутки** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun (it has no singular); nominative plural сутки. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): сутки · суток · суткам · сутки · сутками · сутках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ; therefore: книга — книги, река — реки, госпожа — госпожи.» — DLI, Lesson 23.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Я отниму у тебя всего ___ (минута, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: I'll just take a minute of your time.
exercises.why: **минута → минуту** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. минута · минуты · минуте · минуту · минутой · минуте; pl. минуты · минут · минутам · минуты · минутами · минутах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Уверен, в ___ (близкая неделя, acc. sg.) мы отобьём город.
exercises.prompt: I'm certain we're retaking the city within a week.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's неделя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. неделю). Ending -я → -ю.  **близкий → ближайшую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with неделю). «ближайшую» is a degree form (comparative / superlative) of близкий, not its plain form, so no ending is compared with the plain declension.  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Нам придётся удвоить наш бюджет на ___ (следующий год, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: We'll have to double our budget for next year.
exercises.why: **год → год** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **следующий → следующий** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with год). Adjective type IV, sibilant (after ж, ч, ш, щ) — declines like DLI's хороший (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Был рад, что через ___ (день, acc. sg.) уедет в Петербург.
exercises.why: **день → день** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Молодой человек за ___ (последний день, acc. pl.) сильно изменился в лице.
exercises.why: **день → дни** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural дни. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. автомобили). Ending -ь → -и, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: дн- + -и.  **последний → последние** (acc. pl., agreeing with дни). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: А дерево распускается так же, как и прошлой весной, как много ___ (весна, gen. pl.) назад.
exercises.why: **весна → весен** (gen. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural вёсны. Ending -а → — (no ending; -е- is inserted before the final н: весен).  Declension: sg. весна · весны · весне · весну · весной · весне; pl. вёсны · вёсен · вёснам · вёсны · вёснами · вёснах.  Genitive plural, the four basic types: I — nom. sing. in a consonant (стол, нож): -ов, столов; II — in -ь or a sibilant (словарь, тетрадь): -ей, словарей, тетрадей, ножей; III — in -а, -о (газета, слово): no ending, газет, слов; IV — in -(и)я, -(и)е (лекция, здание): -й, лекций, зданий. — DLI, Lessons 38–41.  «Type III. a) The genitive plural of feminine and neuter nouns of this type often has an inserted -е- or -о- between any two consonants at the end of the word. 1. They always take -е- between a sibilant and к: чашка — чашек, девочка — девочек. 2. They take -о- between any other consonant and к: ошибка — ошибок, машинка — машинок. 3. Memorize: число — чисел, письмо — писем, окно — окон; also деньги — денег. Remember: сестра — сёстры — сестёр; but: место — мест, лампа — ламп, буква — букв, карта — карт. b) неделя — недель, деревня — деревень, туфля — туфель.» — DLI, Lessons 38–41.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
